key_insight: A fixed-frequency lattice-patch of four transmons around one coupler improves connectivity and surface-code compatibility while maintaining high CNOT fidelity.
engineering_relevance: The architecture reduces scaling bottlenecks from frequency crowding and offers a more hardware-aligned building block for fault-tolerant superconducting processors.
method: Couple four fixed-frequency transmons to a single fixed-frequency coupler
Map the qubit layout directly onto a surface-code plaquette
Use virtual Rz phase updates to correct residual cross-resonance phase errors
evidence_signal: Multi-level numerical simulations report CNOT fidelities above 0.98 across all six connectivity directions in the patch.
watch_item: The four-qubit interaction network creates residual phase accumulation during cross-resonance driving, so careful calibration is still required.
paper_title: Lattice patch structure for fixed-frequency transmon quantum computer with high-fidelity CNOT gates
